properties.mlm:pretrained_source: Barlow Twins pretraining on Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 time series

mlm:input.name: sentinel-1-and-2-time-series
mlm:input.description: Per-pixel time series of ten Sentinel-2 reflectance bands plus SCL and Sentinel-1 VV/VH backscatter, split by orbit.

mlm:output.name: embedding
mlm:output.description: 128-dimensional Matryoshka-ordered pixel embedding; the first 16, 32, 64 or 128 dimensions are usable prefixes.

processing.lineage: Pixel embeddings inferred by the TESSERA v2 student model from Sentinel-1 GRD and Sentinel-2 L2A time series using the openEO user-defined process tessera_v2_embeddings.

publications.citation: Feng, Z. et al. (2026) 'TESSERA v2: Scaling pixel-wise Earth foundation models', arXiv:2607.03949
